releaseStatus: local branch feat/black-holes-balance-playtest; no merge or deploy

methodology.probeController: existing fallible BotBrain; roles retain their current shared gameplay rules; no human skill or subjective fun is inferred
methodology.weaponsInArena: all nine production sets across six recipes; ordinary pickup/placement by current AI; every set activation is counted
methodology.decay: actual PlayerSchema.decay, no combat or collecting
methodology.weaponExposure: actual full world update; idle/radial/sideways/warning escape, open arena/wall, with/without spilled gem recovery; contested cases add an unopposed builder following/inhaling
methodology.creditedKnockouts: missile-target versus spent-missile distinguished; state-transition death count is separate; missing milestones mean not reached

limitations: 20 AI-controlled actors, including the human-schema probe; no human skill/fun inference.
Three paired 20-minute seeds and one longer seed are small samples; divergent seeded paths do not establish statistical causation.
Width 500 is an analysis threshold, not a game cap.
Legacy spent-missile event category includes captured-player finishers and spent-ammunition deaths.
Timed-ejection telemetry counts alive non-firing releases; interrupted releases can also be included.
No real Android device performance or hours-long human giant tenure is validated.

captureControls.methodology: Actual server capture/hold/fire/flight-expiry methods at 60Hz; stationary captor, healthy initial captive 100 gems or injury snapshot, ideal full-stick nearest-gem collector. Not chase performance, human ease, fun or final balance.
